d: A label is a small piece of paper attached to an object that gives information about it.
Labor is very hard physical work that people do with their bodies.
A laboratory is a room containing scientific equipment where scientists do their experiments.
A lack of something means there is not enough of it, or none at all.
If you lack something, you do not have it or do not have enough of it.
A ladder is a piece of equipment with wooden or metal steps used for climbing up high.
A lady is a polite, formal word used to refer to a woman.
A lake is a large area of fresh water completely surrounded by land.
A lamp is an object that uses electricity or oil to produce light in a room.
Land is the solid part of the Earth's surface, not covered by the ocean.
When an airplane lands, it safely comes down from the sky onto the ground.
A landscape is everything you can see when you look across a large area of natural land.
A language is the system of spoken and written words that people use to communicate.
Your lap is the flat area formed by your upper legs when you are sitting down.
If something is large, it is very big in physical size or amount.
You use largely to mean mostly or to a very great extent.
A laser is a machine that produces a very strong, highly focused beam of light.
The last person or thing is the one that comes at the very end of a line or series.
If an event lasts for a certain amount of time, it continues happening for that period.
If you are late, you arrive after the time you were expected or supposed to.
If something has happened lately, it happened recently or in the last few days.
If you do something later, you do it at a time in the future rather than right now.
The latest things are the most recent, newest, or most modern ones available.
When you laugh, you make a happy sound with your voice because something is funny.
Laughter is the happy sound that people make when they find something amusing.
If you launch a rocket or a new business, you officially send it into the air or start it.
The law is the system of official rules that everyone in a country must obey.
A lawyer is a professional who understands the law and helps people in court.
If you lay an object somewhere, you put it down carefully in a flat position.
A layer is a flat thickness of a material covering a surface or lying between other materials.
If someone is lazy, they do not want to work hard or make any physical effort.
A leader is the person who is in charge of a group, organization, or country.
Leadership is the ability and skill to guide and manage other people successfully.
A leaf is one of the flat, green parts that grow on the branches of a tree.
A league is a group of sports teams that play against each other to see who is best.
If a pipe leaks, liquid accidentally escapes through a small hole in it.
If you lean against a wall, you rest your body against it for support.
When you learn something, you gain new knowledge or skill by studying or practicing.
A lease is a legal contract where you pay money to use a car or apartment for a set time.
You use least to describe the smallest amount or lowest level of something.
Leather is a strong material made from animal skin, used for making shoes and jackets.
When you leave a place, you go away from it.
A lecture is a formal talk given by a university professor to teach students.
The left side is the side of your body that contains your heart.
Your legs are the two long parts of your body that you use for standing and walking.
A legacy is money or property left to someone in a will after a person dies.
If an action is legal, it is completely allowed by the laws of a country.
A legend is a very old, famous story from ancient times that may not be true.
Legislation consists of the official laws that have been passed by a government.
If something is legitimate, it is fair, reasonable, and allowed by the rules.
A lemon is a yellow, oval fruit with a very sour taste.
If you lend something to someone, you let them borrow it for a short time.
The length of something is the measurement of how long it is from end to end.
You use less to mean a smaller amount of something.
A lesson is a period of time where someone is taught a specific subject or skill.
If you let someone do something, you give them permission to do it.
A letter is a written message that you put in an envelope and send by mail.
A level is a specific height or a stage in a process or video game.
If someone is liberal, they are open to new ideas and respect different beliefs.
A library is a quiet building where you can borrow books to read.
A license is an official document that gives you permission to drive or do business.
If you lie, you deliberately say something that is not true to trick someone.
Life is the state of being alive, from the time you are born until you die.
Your lifestyle is the way you choose to live, including your habits and home.
A lifetime is the entire period of time that a person is alive.
If you lift an object, you use physical strength to move it upwards.
Light is the brightness from the sun or a lamp that allows you to see.
If you like something, you enjoy it or find it pleasant.
If something is likely to happen, there is a very good chance that it will happen.
A limit is the maximum point or amount that is allowed or possible.
A line is a long, thin mark on the surface of something, or a row of people waiting.
A link is a connection between two things, or a button you click on a website.
A lion is a large, powerful wild cat native to Africa.
Your lips are the two soft, pink edges around your mouth.
A liquid is a wet substance like water or milk that flows easily and is not solid.
A list is a series of names, items, or numbers written down on a piece of paper.
When you listen, you pay close attention to a sound or to what someone is saying.
The literal meaning of a word is its exact, most basic meaning without any metaphors.
Literature consists of classic books, poems, and plays that are considered highly artistic.
If something is little, it is very small in size or amount.
A load is a large, heavy amount of goods that is being carried by a truck or person.
A loan is an amount of money you borrow from a bank that you must pay back later.
Local things belong to the specific city or neighborhood where you live.
If you locate something, you successfully find exactly where it is.
A location is a specific geographic place or position.
If you lock a door, you fasten it with a key so that nobody can open it.
Logic is the sensible, scientific way of thinking about a problem to find the truth.
If an idea is logical, it makes complete sense based on the facts.
If you are lonely, you feel sad because you are by yourself and have no friends.
If something is long, it measures a great distance from one end to the other.
If you look at something, you turn your eyes towards it to see it clearly.
If clothes are loose, they are very large and do not fit tightly against your body.
If you lose something, you can no longer find it or you no longer have it.
A loss is the sad feeling or bad situation you experience when something valuable is taken away.
If you live somewhere, you have your permanent home in that place.
A live television or radio program is broadcast exactly as it happens in real time.
If you lead a group of people, you walk in front of them to show them the way.
Lead is a very heavy, soft, dark grey metal used in building and plumbing.
Learned is the past tense of learn, meaning you successfully gained knowledge or a skill.
If someone is learned, they have read many books and possess a massive amount of academic knowledge.
